$comment: Per-exam authoring contract, declared at S3 (exam-author, 2026-08-16). Themes G1-G7 were proposed in derivation/source-gcp-cdl-samples.md (the T1-T8 architecture starter set fits this exam poorly: no autonomy-level, trust-boundary or blast-radius judgments exist at Digital Leader altitude) and are ratified here; theme_definitions carries the one-line judgment each theme exercises. pattern_extensions E01-E08 are the eight mechanisms both Artefact A documents observed that the shared D01-D20 registry does not name (definitions + per-source evidence counts in the two Artefact A docs; caps for E01/E08 in manifest.validation.pattern_caps). Craft rules S4 must apply (from the Artefact A consequence lists, ratified in derivation/master-inventory.md): E06 is the primary wrong-option family; raise E07 sharply; use E03 on the two ordered hierarchies; E05 only for genuinely definitional items; never more than one E08 option per item; no quantified absolutes in wrong options; no any-of-the-above/depends options; negative stems at most one per domain in the good form (all non-keys are correct designs); stem grammar = organisation -> business situation -> one operative constraint -> which product/model/approach; keys only from the guide's named product list; the candidate articulates, never configures. Verticals are authored fresh at S3 as organisation settings for business-transformation scenarios - none is copied from a source scenario.

theme_definitions.G1: Business-value articulation — name the business outcome a capability delivers, against statements that are true but answer a different question
theme_definitions.G2: Product selection — pick the Google Cloud product that performs the required job, against near neighbours that perform adjacent jobs
theme_definitions.G3: Concept discrimination — name the model, term or category the described situation belongs to
theme_definitions.G4: Modernization path choice — pick the migration or compute approach a stated constraint forces
theme_definitions.G5: Data & AI solution fit — match a data or AI approach to the business problem it actually solves
theme_definitions.G6: Trust & security judgment — the control, property or trust mechanism that meets the stated obligation
theme_definitions.G7: Cost & operations governance — spend accountability, consumption control, reliability measurement
